entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR SINHA  ORAL ORDER 9 18-12-2025 1.
It is a dispute between husband and wife.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that both the parties are in the process of amicable settlement and terms of settlement has been filed in the divorce case lodged by the petitioner at Delhi Court.

3. The opposite party no. 2 has already filed a petition before the concerned court for withdrawal of the present case lodged under section 498A of the I.P.C.
4.

In view of the aforesaid, put up this case under the heading "For Admission" for filing necessary affidavit bringing on record the terms of settlement by the petitioner.
5. Put up after four weeks i.e. on 19.01.2026.
praful/- (Anil Kumar Sinha, J)
